CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA: feat(nock): SQLite-backed texture library CRUD + clone, modeled on CarePyre's resume clone (many independent master textures, not one master with derived views) -- new nock_textures table, internal/nock/texture_store.go, full REST + CLI, minimal GUI tab. Also wired real Tailwind CSS v4 into the frontend. Confirmed PARENA has no JSX/React generation capability (investigated, resolved via AskUserQuestion to keep hand-writing TSX). See docs/NOCK_NORTHSTAR.md. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
